vulnerable_statements.reason: After idmap_lookup() succeeds, item holds a reference on the idtoname cache entry. If xdr_reserve_space() fails, the function returns nfserr_resource without calling cache_put(&item->h, nn->idtoname_cache), leaking the cache entry reference. A client that keeps triggering this path (e.g. by making the reply buffer run out of space) can pin cache entries indefinitely and exhaust kernel memory.

suggested_fix: Release the cache reference on every exit after a successful lookup. For example, on xdr_reserve_space() failure, call cache_put(&item->h, nn->idtoname_cache) before returning nfserr_resource. Alternatively, set a status variable and use a single exit path that always calls cache_put().
